title: wattmind/buzz config — Buzz relay, channel, and poll settings

channel.title: Inbox channel
channel.description: NIP-29 channel uuid for kind-9 posts (`h` tag). Default is #general on the watt-mind relay.

feedChannel.title: Factory feed channel
feedChannel.description: NIP-29 channel uuid for run lifecycle telemetry. When unset, lifecycle events are omitted and never fall back to the inbox/pager channel. #feed-factory is 8469ab53-6292-4436-938f-edf77ad2a652 on the Watt Mind relay.

dmBlockedTo.title: DM blocked-to
dmBlockedTo.description: Owner pubkey hex. When set, BLOCKED / CIRCUIT BREAKER / SMOKE RED items are also sent as a NIP-17 DM.

agentNsec.title: Agent nsec
agentNsec.description: Factory agent secret key (nsec or 64-hex). Resolved from FACTORY_EXT_BUZZ_AGENT_NSEC.

authTag.title: NIP-OA auth tag
authTag.description: JSON array ["auth", owner, conditions, sig]. Resolved from FACTORY_EXT_BUZZ_AUTH_TAG.

webUrl.title: Factory web URL
webUrl.description: Absolute http(s) origin for inbox deep links. Hash-only #/inbox/… links are never posted.

postKinds.title: Post kinds
postKinds.description: Inbox kinds posted to the interrupt channel. Default is the pager set only; run-start telemetry is a later #feed-factory channel (WM-975).

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to query the relay for reactions, replies, and commands.

approvers.title: Approvers
approvers.description: Pubkey hex allow-list for reactions, replies, and commands. Empty = owner pubkey from the auth tag.
